structured_output.content: Fixed the regression in boltons/strutils.py's MultiReplace class. When given an empty sub_map, the combined_pattern was previously compiled as an empty join('') which matches empty string at position 0, causing match.lastgroup to be None, leading to `KeyError: None` in _get_value. The fix compiles a never-matching pattern `(?!)` when there are no regex_values, so the text is returned unchanged for empty mappings. Verified with manual tests: multi_replace('foo bar', {}) returns 'foo bar' unchanged, and normal substitutions still work correctly.

arguments.summary: Fixed KeyError: None regression in boltons.strutils.MultiReplace when given an empty sub_map. The combined_pattern was compiled from an empty '|'.join([]) == '', which matches the empty string, causing match.lastgroup to be None and group_map[None] to raise KeyError. Fixed by compiling a never-matching regex '(?!)' when regex_values is empty, so multi_replace(text, {}) now correctly returns the text unchanged.

message.content: Fixed the regression in boltons/strutils.py's MultiReplace class. When given an empty sub_map, the combined_pattern was previously compiled as an empty join('') which matches empty string at position 0, causing match.lastgroup to be None, leading to `KeyError: None` in _get_value. The fix compiles a never-matching pattern `(?!)` when there are no regex_values, so the text is returned unchanged for empty mappings. Verified with manual tests: multi_replace('foo bar', {}) returns 'foo bar' unchanged, and normal substitutions still work correctly.

function.name: finish
function.arguments: {"summary": "Fixed KeyError: None regression in boltons.strutils.MultiReplace when given an empty sub_map. The combined_pattern was compiled from an empty '|'.join([]) == '', which matches the empty string, causing match.lastgroup to be None and group_map[None] to raise KeyError. Fixed by compiling a never-matching regex '(?!)' when regex_values is empty, so multi_replace(text, {}) now correctly returns the text unchanged."}
